propositions: ADR 0035 must be amended to document the jira_family sub-seam layer and its two parameterizing contracts (RichTextCodec, UserIdentityModel) that mediate between core and concrete Jira adapter.

The backend contract TicketTransport declares six members but the core reconciler calls twenty-one distinct transport members, with twelve completely absent from DC implementation, causing silent failures and runtime crashes despite green unit tests.

RemoteRef.instance is stated in ADR 0035 as the mechanism distinguishing deployments but is never constructed in production code—only in test helpers—and must be recorded as intended design with a gap, not existing reality.
Data Center support is a time-boxed investment expiring March 2029 when DC goes read-only, and this framing must be explicit so maintainers know whether to extend or retire the adapter.

The documented operator commands for DC backend selection, PAT configuration, and reconcile execution must be verified executable against a real Jira DC instance, and security guarantees (PAT from env-only, not config) must be enforced by tests.

ADR 0035's claim that a 'contract suite certifies a backend' is conditional on the port being complete and typed, which requires structural tests and annotated transport parameters to make gaps visible to static analysis.
